title: The Sap Camp
journal: The note from the reed hide sends the sap-takers' jars to Karsh-Naal Camp, a Naga camp in the marsh east of Teel-Fen Weir. I should go there and find out who takes them.
objectives: Go to Karsh-Naal Camp and find out who takes the jars. (marker: Karsh-Naal Camp, Sesk's Cage)

plan.going: The sap goes to Karsh-Naal Camp, a camp of Naga.
plan.next: Go to the camp and find out who takes the jars.
plan.ways: The guards stay at the fire by the longhouse; a caged prisoner at the camp's west edge calls out to anyone who comes near.

answers: I am Tarin, a thief freed by Vosh-Leera of Jal-Veesa, who works for the Toh-Reel-Ka. Sap-takers are taking Hist sap from scarred trees and sealing the scars with grey paste; the Teel-Fen Weir tree may die. A note ordered jars brought to Karsh-Naal Camp.
Go to Karsh-Naal Camp, east of the weir, and find out who takes the jars.
Talk to Jeeta-Sakka, look at the jars, or approach the locked Sesk's Cage; guards are dangerous so fighting is risky.
I do not know who leads the Unbound, what the grey paste is, why sap is wanted, or who Sesk is. I could ask people here, Weeltul or Vosh-Leera.

title: The Sap Camp
journal: Sesk talked as soon as I opened her cage. She drew sap for the Unbound, a cult of the tribeless whose leader is Cuts-the-Old-Knot, an Argonian woman. The sap is for a draught she brews, and the draught has something to do with "the Eye". They call the grey paste in the scars "the seal". Why drain a tree and then seal it, if they only want its sap? Vosh-Leera in Jal-Veesa should hear this.
objectives: Tell Vosh-Leera in Jal-Veesa what Sesk said. (marker: Vosh-Leera)

plan.going: The Unbound, led by Cuts-the-Old-Knot, drain trees for a draught to do with "the Eye", and seal the scars. The question I carry: why seal a tree they only want sap from?
plan.next: Go back to Vosh-Leera in Jal-Veesa and tell her.

answers: I freed Sesk, who drew sap for the Unbound, a cult of the tribeless led by Cuts-the-Old-Knot, an Argonian woman who moves about. Jars come to this camp then go to her; the sap goes into a draught for something to do with "the Eye". The grey paste is called the seal.
Go back to Vosh-Leera in Jal-Veesa and tell her.
I could go straight to Vosh-Leera, or first ask Sesk more questions, or look for Cuts-the-Old-Knot myself, which seems dangerous.
I do not know what the Eye is, what is in the seal, or where Cuts-the-Old-Knot is. Vosh-Leera or Weeltul may know.

title: The Sap Camp
journal: Vosh-Leera says this is more than a herald can judge, and paid me a hundred gold. She is sending me to the order's handler, Nesh-Deeka, at her house in Helstrom, far to the south through deadly country. She told me to ride the rootworm: a great blind worm that swims the waters under the roots from one Hist's pool to another's. It stops at a tree's root pool, the open water among the roots at its foot, where a root-tender calls it and takes the fare. Here the tender is Weeltul, at the Hist pool in the middle of the town, and the fare is twenty-five gold. I should ask her to send me.
objectives: Ask Weeltul at Jal-Veesa's Hist pool about the rootworm to Helstrom. (marker: Weeltul)

plan.going: I am sent on to the order's handler, Nesh-Deeka, in Helstrom.
plan.next: Ask Weeltul, the root-tender at Jal-Veesa's Hist pool, to send me to Helstrom by the rootworm.
plan.ways: One way; the road on foot runs through deadly country.

answers: I work for the Toh-Reel-Ka through Vosh-Leera. The Unbound drain Hist trees for sap for a draught tied to "the Eye", then seal the scars. Vosh-Leera says it is beyond her and paid me 100 gold.
Go to Weeltul at the Hist pool in Jal-Veesa, pay 25 gold, and ride the rootworm to Helstrom to find Nesh-Deeka, the order handler.
Take the rootworm as told, or travel another way, though the land is deadly. I could also prepare first.
I do not know what the Eye is, what the seal is made of, or exactly where Nesh-Deeka lives beyond her named door. Weeltul and the Helstrom root-tender can guide me.

title: The Sap Camp
journal: Weeltul will call the rootworm for me from Jal-Veesa's pool to the pool under Helstrom's city tree, for twenty-five gold paid to her. At Helstrom I need to find Nesh-Deeka's House; the root-tender there can point the way.

plan.going: I know what the rootworm is, where to take it and what it costs.
plan.next: Pay Weeltul the fare, ride to Helstrom and find Nesh-Deeka's House.
